fields.description: MCP tool name (matches the tool's registered name, e.g. list_ap_invoices). Unique.
fields.label: Tool Name

fields.description: Ops kill switch. When unchecked the tool is hidden from tools/list and rejected on tools/call.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Optional. If set, the caller must have this role for the tool to be listed or called.
fields.label: Required Role

fields.description: OAuth scope the caller's token must carry, e.g. erpnext:ap_invoice:read.
fields.label: Required OAuth Scope

fields.description: Max calls per minute per user for this tool. 0 disables the per-tool limit.
fields.label: Rate Limit (per minute, per user)

fields.description: Max concurrent in-flight calls per user for this tool. 0 disables the concurrency cap.
fields.label: Concurrency Cap (per user)

fields.description: Soft timeout for the tool in seconds (advisory; recorded on the audit row).
fields.label: Timeout (seconds)
